purpose: Verify whether historical lcc-claw-node-qpy runtime can still reach the cloud OpenClaw gateway on the current EC800K board and cellular path.
conclusion: Historical lcc-claw-node-qpy runtime does not bypass the current transport problem.
On the same EC800K board, same SIM path, and same cloud OpenClaw gateway, the legacy runtime fails exactly at the plain WebSocket handshake stage.
This rules out qpyclaw-only implementation drift as the primary cause of the current direct-cloud failure.
